    /// `POST /uploads`
    public func uploadBundle(body: UploadBundleRequest, options: RequestOptions = .init()) async throws -> UploadBundleResponse {
        var parts: [MultipartPart] = []
        parts.append(MultipartPart(name: "manifest", value: .text(body.manifest)))
        parts.append(MultipartPart(name: "artifact", value: .file(body.artifact)))
        if let value = body.sha256 {
            parts.append(MultipartPart(name: "sha256", value: .text(value)))
        }
        return try await client.send(RequestSpec(
            method: "POST",
            path: "/uploads",
            body: .multipart(parts),
            options: options
        ))
